angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 930,847 km at 96.88 pc = 0.13 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 10.3218 +/- 0.0180 mas (same row, RUWE 1.01): 96.88 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.338 +/- 0.032 solar radii from Giovinazzi et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of KELT-24 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..118G/abstract): 930,847 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.268 +/- 0.063 solar masses from Giovinazzi et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of KELT-24 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..118G/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6426 +/- 93 K from Giovinazzi et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KELT-24 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..118G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Giovinazzi et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KELT-24 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..118G/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kelt-24.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.288, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-24 (pscomppars): spectral type F7, from Hjorth et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...631A..76H/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 93148: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-24 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.138 dex, from Giovinazzi et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..118G/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-24 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.43933, from Giovinazzi et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..118G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-24 (pscomppars): age 1.98 Gyr, from Giovinazzi et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..118G/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-24 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 19.74 km/s, from Giovinazzi et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..118G/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
